source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Adds 157 merchants (116 -> 273), weighted to what 20-45 Indian users actually spend on. Fills three app categories that had ZERO merchants: home_decor, wallet_load, government. apparel 6 -> 30 and personal_care 2 -> 16 were the biggest gaps. Every category_id is a slug from the app's own bundled categories.json; no non-fuel merchant carries a fuel MCC.
